messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY: high latency alert for customer=zenithpay, pool=dedicated-cp-zen-01, region=eu-central, metric=p99_latency, threshold=800ms. Pager: @jordan.sre @maya.eng

jordan.sre: Root alert - we're seeing p99 ~1.8s on the ZenithPay dedicated pool in eu-central. Customer is on reserved capacity. Impact: transaction checkout latency spikes.

maya.eng: I'm in. Pulling recent traces and allocs now. Any recent deploys?

leo.prod: No deploys from ZenithPay side. They confirm no changes on their end. AM Clare looped in on call with customer.

clare-am: On the call with their TSE now, they report intermittent failed retries and user complaints. They asked if this is SLO or degraded throughput.

maya.eng: Stack traces show long tail on the attention kernel step, specifically GPU stalls on node gpux-12 in the pool. `nvidia-smi` shows ~98% memory; processes pinned.

jordan.sre: Any tokenization or prompt size surges from the customer?

zenithpay-tse: We're running some batch reconciliation jobs overnight but not at this minute. Normal traffic is payment auth and receipts.

maya.eng: Querying metrics: 10% of requests hitting that node have >2x sequence length than baseline. Looks like a malformed batch is causing KV cache misses and forcing full re-encode on every request.

sophia.ops: Can we isolate tenant to different nodes or throttle ephemeral batch sizes? We should avoid broad pool restarts.

jordan.sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) Apply per-tenant circuit breaker to ZenithPay on routing layer to cap max_seq_len=1024 and fallback to smaller model variant. 2) Evacuate traffic from gpux-12 -> initiate graceful drain. 3) Short-term autoscale extra worker with quantized variant. 4) Notify customer.

maya.eng: I can push a routing policy patch: `route override tenant=zenithpay max_seq=1024 fallback_model=redwood-compact-q4` — deploying to canary in eu-central now.

incident-bot: ACTION: routing policy patch created by maya.eng, canary rollout started to 5% of zenithpay traffic.

leo.prod: Clare, can you tell customer we're doing an adaptive rate and model fallback, expect improvement in 3-5m?

clare-am: On the line: I told them we are applying mitigations and will update in 5 min. They asked about data isolation — confirm it's still in their dedicated pool.

jordan.sre: Yes routing fallback keeps them in dedicated pool, just switching to quantized model variant on a subset. No cross-tenant migration.

maya.eng: gpux-12 drain started: `kubectl cordon gpux-12 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data gpux-12` - evicting 8 pods, will re-schedule. Autoscale requested: +2 q4 nodes.

sophia.ops: Autoscale accepted; provisioning two q4-small instances in eu-central, ETA ~4m.

pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff scheduled in 30m to maya.eng -> next oncall jordan.sre.

zenithpay-tse: We see p99 dropping to ~900ms after the canary. Good signal. Any risk of throughput change?

maya.eng: Throughput holding. The fallback reduces per-request cost and memory pressure. Still watching KV miss rate.

jordan.sre: If canary holds for 10m, expand to 50% then full. Also enable temporary request-level retry suppression for requests >3s to avoid clogging.

maya.eng: Canary at 25% now. p95 ~250ms, p99 ~620ms overall for zenithpay.

clare-am: Customer says degraded but acceptable for now. They want a postmortem and root cause. I'll schedule follow-up with them and AM notes.

maya.eng: Canary full rollout complete. Routing policy applied to 100% zenithpay. gpux-12 drained successfully; eviction logs attached in #eng-runtime if anyone needs them.

jordan.sre: Marking immediate mitigation complete. Still need root cause: verify whether batching logic on their side or our aggregator misclassified sequence lengths.

maya.eng: Logs show a series of 1,200-token requests from a single client IP within zenithpay's tenant over a 6-minute window — likely a reconciliation job mis-tagged as low-priority and batched too tightly.

sophia.ops: Will add temporary rate-limit rule on tenant for concurrent large sequences: `ratelimit tenant=zenithpay concurrent_large_seq=8`

zenithpay-tse: We'll patch our job to limit token chunks and skip heavy batching until you confirm. Thanks.

jordan.sre: Assigning actions: maya.eng -> post-incident root cause (kernel stall + oversized batch causing KV churn). sophia.ops -> make ratelimit permanent until quantization profiling done. clare-am -> customer comms + PM. leo.prod -> coordinate postmortem and SLA impact calc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status=mitigated, mitigation_time=2026-03-15T14:32:00Z, owner=jordan.sre

jordan.sre: Closing war room for now. We'll keep monitoring through the next 2 hours. If p99 creeps above 800ms reopen. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
